title: The Secret Scholarship
author: Rafael Hartwell
blurb: Kestrel Oyelaran, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, has spent twelve years being so careful it hurts. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
